messages:
maya: Heads-up — my calendar shows two Ops-sync events every Wednesday starting last week. One has an old Zoom link, the other the new one. Noticed after someone edited recurrence. @jon @priya any idea?

jon: I saw that too on my end. Looks like Google duplicated the series when the organizer switched. Pretty sure it happens if you edit series while a forwarded invite exists.

priya: Yep — happened to me once. The forwarded copy becomes a separate series (same title, different eventId). Quick check: are the two events in different calendars (personal vs eng-platform team calendar)?

maya: One is on "Maya R." calendar, the other on "eng-platform" team calendar. Zoom links different IDs. calendar-bot posted a delivery failure around the same time.

calendar-bot: automated: Delivery error: forwarded-invite-1234 failed to sync to eng-platform calendar at 2026-03-10T14:02:11Z.

carlos: If the meeting organizer changed (someone re-created and made themselves organizer), Google often creates a new series instead of updating the existing one. We should: 1) pick canonical owner (team calendar) 2) create new recurring event there with correct Zoom 3) cancel the other series and ask attendees to remove duplicates.

jon: Agreed. Short-term hack: open the "old" event -> More actions -> "Remove from calendar" for the personal one. For a clean fix, cancel the old series (owner must cancel) otherwise invites linger.

priya: I can be owner on the team calendar. Quick checklist: a) create new recurring event (weekly) on eng-platform calendar b) paste canonical Zoom link (meeting id + passcode in description) c) set conferencing provider to Zoom so Google updates link properly d) cancel the other series and send cancelation.

maya: Thanks. Two asks: can we avoid changing recurrence rules while forwarding? Also timezone note — people in APAC saw the time shift because Google reinterpreted the rule when duplicate created. That caused a bunch of confusion in the chat this morning.

carlos: Good call. We should add a tiny doc in eng-platform: "How to migrate a recurring meeting to the team calendar" — steps + script to find duplicate series by title/date. I can draft it.

jon: For automation, we can run a small Google Calendar API script to find overlapping series with same title within +-2 days and surface them. Example snippet to list events for calendarId:

```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
  "https://www.googleapis.com/calendar/v3/calendars/eng-platform@company.com/events?timeMin=2026-03-01T00:00:00Z&timeMax=2026-04-01T00:00:00Z&singleEvents=true"
```

Then compare summary + recurrence/rdate. We can mark likely duplicates and message owners.

priya: That sounds useful. For the immediate Ops-sync this week: I'll create the canonical event on eng-platform calendar at 08:30 PT / 16:30 BST (keeps APAC folks in evening). If that doesn't work we can poll.

maya: Works for me. Can you also set description with the canonical link and add "If you have a duplicate event, delete it from your calendar and accept the new one" text?

priya: Will do. I'll also cancel the old series (owner: Maya) — Maya, you'll get a cancel notice; please don't re-add the series.

maya: Got it. I'll confirm once canceled. Also quick follow-up: should we migrate recurring meetings to the eng-platform calendar by default?

carlos: Yes — policy proposal: team recurring ops/design/triage meetings should be created on the team calendar and use Zoom account X with "Only authenticated users" off for guests. I'll put a PR in the handbook.

jon: One more practical tip: if folks still see ghost invites, ask them to go to Settings -> Events from Gmail / RSVPs and remove any forwarded copies, then clear cached invites in the web UI. Sometimes the mobile app keeps a phantom.

priya: Done — created canonical event and shared link: https://zoom.us/j/999888777 (passcode in description). Cancel request sent to the old series just now.

maya: I see the new event. Removed the duplicate on my calendar. Thanks!

calendar-bot: automated: Event created on eng-platform@company.com: Ops Sync (Weekly) — next occurrence 2026-03-18T15:30:00Z.

carlos: I'll draft the handbook snippet + small script and drop a link here when ready. Also proposing a small rubric for changing recurrences (notify owner + avoid forwarding mid-migration).

maya: Thanks everyone. If anyone still has issues, DM me and we'll clean up.

jon: Awesome — closing this thread. :white_check_mark:
